C-SAFE-PUBLIC-BOUNDARY.Name: Enforce the approved publication boundary before commit and push
C-SAFE-PUBLIC-BOUNDARY.Summary: Extend the owner-mandated safety protocol to reject reserved private operational paths and captured-profile additions before local publication, following the separately approved C-PRIVATE-OPERATIONS policy now integrated into main.
C-SAFE-PUBLIC-BOUNDARY.ApprovalBasis: Owner required secrets/paths/artifact checks and mandatory local-model review/recheck before every commit and push. The approved publication-policy.md identifies reserved private paths. This enforces that policy without moving more records or changing product behavior.

Goals.Goal: Block accidental force-add or staged reintroduction of reserved owner operations and non-public fixture captures in both delivery lanes.

Constraints.Constraint: Keep all full-blob scans, raw identity checks and serial model passes; retain six sanitized preference examples and public reusable release tooling. No private companion writes, history rewrite or release.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No App Store operation, source/history cleanup, runtime behavior or mobile release change.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Reserved private paths fail before inference; retained synthetic preference examples and public release tools pass. Existing gate tests remain passing.

AffectedAreas.Area: M-064/V-M-064 safety gate, tests and public protocol documentation.
